newsitem.title: INDIA: HFCL sees 97/98 net at 500 mln rupees.
newsitem.headline: HFCL sees 97/98 net at 500 mln rupees.

text.p: India's Himachal Futuristic Communications Ltd (HFCL) said on Tuesday it expected its net profit in 1997/98 (April-March) to reach 500 million rupees compared to 165.8 million rupees in 1996/97.

"We expect sales to touch 3.5 billion rupees this year. We expect one billion rupees worth of orders from the Department of Telecommunications and have already received two billion worth from private operators," HFCL director Mahendra Nahata told Reuters.
"Our profit for the year should touch 500 million rupees," he said.
